about: The devices that take part in a fight without being creatures (the owner, 5 November: taking part in a fight does not make a thing a monster): engines, wards, barriers, charges and vessels, from Orsino's combatEntity template (its class "device"). Each is made by the one chassis that makes creatures, from its own record: its qualities, hit points, natural strike, powers and nature; it is set where it stands by an author (Device turret.) or by a site that has one, never called up by a summoning, never met in a den.

turret.name: Turret
turret.description: An engine of the makers that looses bolts at whatever moves in front of it.
turret.looks: A squat engine of iron on a swivel, bolts racked in its throat, that looses at whatever moves before it.

source.notes: Orsino's device: every quality 3, eight hit points, inanimate, waiting when it has nothing to do, and its own powers; it fights where it was set and is never a creature (Kyr strikes with a slam where Orsino's strikes for 1d2 true damage). Its material is Kyr's.

antimagic_ward.name: Antimagic ward
antimagic_ward.description: A circle of cut stones that hums when magic is near, and silences it.
antimagic_ward.looks: A standing stone cut with interlocking marks, cold to the hand, that makes the air dull around it.

barrier.description: A wall of force or of stone set across the way, which does nothing but stand there and be in it.
barrier.looks: A wall of beams and stakes set across the way, braced to take a blow.
